project_type: TypeScript/Vite web app with standalone HTML content files for social media marketing
test_framework: none - standalone HTML content files do not have tests
test_command: none applicable for HTML content files
verification_instructions: Verify HTML files exist in satuyangterpenting/ folder, open them in browser to confirm rendering, check all 21 posts per file, verify CTA links and button styling
setup_instructions: npm install (for main app only; HTML content files are standalone)
environment_constraints: HTML content files are standalone - no build required. Verification is file existence and valid HTML structure.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing HTML content file patterns (see Petrusjakub-IG-content.html, SuzanKim-content.html). Indonesian language. Polite language (no gue/gua/elo/elu).
key_patterns: Each HTML file is self-contained with embedded CSS and JS. Uses card-based layout with post-card class. Each post has caption-box with copy button functionality. Navigation links at top. Gradient backgrounds. Mobile responsive. Footer section.
directory_structure: Root level contains HTML content files, TypeScript app files (App.tsx, index.tsx), and config (package.json, tsconfig.json, vite.config.ts). New folder 'satuyangterpenting/' will be created at root level containing week1-week7 HTML files.
